items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: And that's Black Mac's close buddies. He said, if you mess with him, Black Mac will get you... They said, take a liking to me, you see. And, well, that's it. A good friendly association treated me like a king.

ctx.x: It was only about six blocks from the place where I was playing, which was predominantly the Negro neighborhood. And they had this railroad track down there, as you recall, it was called Central Track. And that's where all the thugs lived. And I guess I was too younger to realize the danger. So he told me, you better get on home and get on home and run quickly, right quickly, because some of you niggas will take your head off. He thought I was a white boy. Yeah. So I said, okay, I thanked him so much, so I left…
How long has it been since you've been on a streetcar?
